en-US.description: Desktop app for downloading, saving and managing iPhone and iPad apps.
en-US.longDescription:
iPAGet is a desktop app for downloading, saving and managing iPhone and iPad apps on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Download App Store apps as IPA files, choose an older release from the version history, or connect a device to download the same build it has installed. Keep the packages locally for later reinstallation.

The app also includes device app management, an IPA editor, certificate management and re-signing.

Downloads and versions:
- Search by App Store region and view charts, app details and release notes.
- Download the latest release or select a specific version from the version history.
- Use multiple Apple Accounts, track download progress and speed, and manage downloaded or imported IPAs in the local library.

Device app management:
- View device information, installed apps and their storage use.
- Install IPAs, uninstall apps and transfer files through the app containers that iOS makes accessible.

IPA inspection and editing:
- Inspect bundle identifiers, versions and build numbers, minimum OS requirements, provisioning profiles, entitlements, frameworks and encryption status.
- Change an app's display name, icon and Info.plist, then export the modified IPA.
- Edit property lists as a tree or as XML, with support for XML and binary Plist formats.

Certificates and signing:
- Import an existing certificate or request a signing certificate through an Apple developer account.
- Sign or re-sign an IPA with a certificate and provisioning profile.
en-US.name: iPAGet

zh-CN.description: 用于下载、保存和管理 iPhone、iPad 应用的桌面应用。
zh-CN.longDescription:
iPAGet 用于在电脑上下载、保存和管理 iPhone、iPad 应用，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。

你可以将 App Store 应用下载为 IPA 文件，从版本历史中选择旧版，也可以连接设备，下载与设备当前安装版本一致的 IPA。安装包保存在本地，方便留存和重装。

除了下载，iPAGet 还提供设备应用管理、IPA 编辑、证书管理和重新签名功能。

下载与版本管理：
- 按商店地区搜索应用，查看榜单、应用详情和更新说明。
- 下载最新版，或从版本历史中选择指定版本。
- 支持多个 Apple 账号，显示下载进度与速度，在本地应用库中管理下载或导入的 IPA。

设备应用管理：
- 查看设备信息、已安装应用及其存储占用。
- 安装 IPA、卸载应用，浏览应用允许访问的文件容器并传输文件。

IPA 查看与编辑：
- 查看包标识、版本与构建号、最低系统要求、描述文件、授权项、框架和加密状态。
- 修改应用显示名称、图标及 Info.plist，导出修改后的 IPA。
- 使用树形视图或 XML 编辑属性列表，支持 XML 与二进制 Plist。

证书与签名：
- 导入已有证书，或通过 Apple 开发者账号申请签名证书。
- 使用证书与描述文件对 IPA 进行签名或重新签名。
